title: SRE-Lead Eval Case
description: One held-out eval case for the sre-lead advisory persona: a reliability-review input paired with its expected risk-tiered advisory. Each line of evals/sre-lead/<split>/cases.jsonl is one object of this shape. The persona classifies a change's reliability risk and lands a concrete recommendation, so the expected decision is risk-tiered (risk_tier / escalate / recommend) — NOT the triage {escalate, risk} shape of evals/case.schema.json. This is the trust anchor for the persona's skill-quality measurement and is CODEOWNER-gated separately from any scorer/proposer.

id.description: Stable, unique kebab-case identifier for the case. Unique within a split and disjoint across dev/holdout (enforced by evals/validate-cases.py).

description.description: Human-readable note on what this case exercises and which reliability principle grounds the expected decision.

tags.description: Optional labels for coverage tracking, e.g. the reliability concern a case exercises ('observability', 'slo', 'disaster-recovery', 'negative').

input.description: The pre-fetched review context exactly as the advisory consumes it: a self-contained description of the proposed change under reliability review.

expected.description: The fixed, reward-hack-resistant expected reliability advisory the persona must produce for this change.

risk_tier.description: Expected reliability risk classification. Any HIGH signal must pair with escalate=true.

escalate.description: Whether the advisory must flag the change for escalation (true) or may say no escalation is warranted (false).

recommend.description: The reliability recommendation the advisory must land, grounded in the SRE principle the case exercises.
